title: Batch actual Wiki changes instead of counting all database rows
requirements: Count actual changed published facts, topics and slang against the last successfully published snapshot; persist baseline across restarts.
Ignore access counters, source row order and unpublished candidates when computing versions and publication thresholds.

At the next source check, prioritize removal of published records and allow empty replacements without manual force. Preserve the existing publication interval, forced refresh and source-check throttle.
